description: This file contains definitions for several Grain classes used in unit testing the placement and activation strategies in an Orleans project. It includes an abstract base class for placement testing grains, specific implementations with different placement strategies, and some test-specific grains for local content management and content fetching. The file also references multiple Orleans system components and testing interfaces, focusing on testing grain placement, activation, and environment statistics handling.

classes.name: PlacementTestGrainBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for test grains that focus on placement strategies. Provides methods for getting endpoint, runtime ID, activation ID, and managing environment statistics.

classes.name: RandomPlacementTestGrain
classes.description: A test grain decorated with RandomPlacement attribute, inherits from PlacementTestGrainBase to test random placement strategy.

classes.name: PreferLocalPlacementTestGrain
classes.description: A test grain with PreferLocalPlacement attribute, inherits from PlacementTestGrainBase to test local placement strategy.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerPlacementTestGrain
classes.description: A stateless worker grain with a set worker limit (1), inherits from PlacementTestGrainBase, used to test deployment of stateless worker grains.

classes.name: OtherStatelessWorkerPlacementTestGrain
classes.description: Another stateless worker grain with a different worker limit (2), used for similar testing purposes.

classes.name: ActivationCountBasedPlacementTestGrain
classes.description: A grain with ActivationCountBasedPlacement attribute, used to test activation count-based placement.

classes.name: DefaultPlacementGrain
classes.description: A simple grain that provides access to the default placement strategy via a method.

classes.name: LocalContentGrain
classes.description: A grain for managing local silo-specific content, used in local content tests. Caches silo identity and persists it.

classes.name: TestContentGrain
classes.description: A grain designed to test content fetching, particularly to retrieve content from the local content grain across silos.

methods.name: GetEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the network endpoint of the grain's silo.

methods.name: GetRuntimeInstanceId
methods.description: Returns the runtime identity ID.

methods.name: GetActivationId
methods.description: Returns the unique activation ID of the grain instance.

methods.name: Nop
methods.description: A no-operation method to initialize grains.

methods.name: StartLocalGrains
methods.description: Starts multiple local grains given a list of keys.

methods.name: StartPreferLocalGrain
methods.description: Starts a specific grain with a predefined key.

methods.name: SampleLocalGrainEndpoint
methods.description: Samples endpoints from a specified local grain.

methods.name: SampleLocalGrainEndpoint (overload)
methods.description: Fetches multiple sample endpoints for a given grain key.

methods.name: PropagateStatisticsToCluster
methods.description: Triggers propagation of environment statistics across the cluster.

methods.name: EnableOverloadDetection
methods.description: Enables or disables overload detection on the grain.

methods.name: LatchOverloaded
methods.description: Latches hardware statistics to simulate overload condition.

methods.name: UnlatchOverloaded
methods.description: Removes overload status from hardware statistics.

methods.name: LatchCpuUsage
methods.description: Overrides CPU usage in environment statistics for testing.

methods.name: UnlatchCpuUsage
methods.description: Resets CPU usage statistics to normal.

methods.name: GetLocation
methods.description: Returns the silo address where the grain is located.

methods.name: GetDefaultPlacement
methods.description: Returns the default placement strategy for the grain.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the local content grain.

methods.name: GetContent
methods.description: Retrieves the cached content, typically the silo identity.

methods.name: FetchContentFromLocalGrain
methods.description: Fetches content from the local content grain to verify local access.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles grain activation, setting up cached content and preventing deactivation.
